'''Żabbar St. Patrick Football Club''' is a [[Malta|Maltese]] professional [[football (soccer)|football]] club from the town of [[Żabbar]], which currently plays in the [[Maltese Premier League]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Maltese Football Association Website for Zabbar St. Patrick|url=https://www.mfa.com.mt/en/leagues/leagues/92/bov-amateur-league-b.htm?feature=teams&mp=213}}</ref> The club was founded in 1912. They also play in the annual [[Maltese FA Trophy]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Times of Malta Reporting the draw for the 2019–20 FA Trophy|url=https://timesofmalta.com/articles/view/draws-of-2019-20-fa-trophy-opening-rounds-made.727661}}</ref>"}}
